fato_historico: 1781: American Revolutionary War: The siege of Yorktown comes to an end with the British surrender.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to release old burdens, much like a long-held siege finally yielding to peace. It is a good time to recognize your inner strength and surrender any lingering resistance. Consider this a fresh start for your spirit, as you may find that letting go opens the path to a triumphant and bright new chapter.
frase_do_dia: True victory is found in the courage to begin again with a hopeful heart.
significado_numero: Represents the completion of a cycle and the start of independence.
conselho: Focus on releasing outdated worries to welcome fresh luck into your life.
